items.title: Haryana: Congress stages statewide protest seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
items.summary: Chandigarh, Sep 28 (PTI) Congress’ Haryana unit on Monday held demonstrations and marches across the state, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and a comprehensive review of all election-related decisions taken during his tenure.
